SilphCo_4F_Text_CantYouSeeImHiding.fr: Chut !\nTu ne vois pas que je me cache ?

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro.en: TEAM ONYBRIS has taken control\nof HEMATEK CO.!

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle.en: Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!

SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.en: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!
SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle.fr: Je ferais mieux de prévenir le BOSS\nau 11F !

SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro.en: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.

SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle.en: The doors are electronically\nlocked.\pIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.
SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle.fr: Les portes sont verrouillées\nélectroniquement.\pIl faut une CARTE MAGNÉTIQUE pour\nouvrir les portes ici.
